about: CS2-style HUD elements injected into HUDMainMenu (tile CSNV_HUD). Positions are in New Vegas UI units measured from the anchor corner of screen(). Original art only; nothing from Valve's files.

columns.id: unique element id (also the tile name in csnv_hud.xml)
columns.label: what it shows
columns.x: horizontal offset from the anchor (positive = inwards)
columns.y: vertical offset from the anchor (positive = upwards; for center, positive = down)
columns.format: how the value is printed ({value}, {clip}, {reserve}); 'crosshair' = drawn from cs2_settings
columns.art: assets/ file drawn next to it, or 'text' for text only
columns.verified: true once seen in the running game
